warnings: Measures the HIT AREA — the bounding rect plus the overhang read off each element's own ::after — never the rect. A rect-only scan under-measures every control using the negative-inset pattern by its overhang and calls a legal control broken.

The pitch of `.choices` was the first suspicion and is innocent: the band is 44px on a 46px pitch, and the lost rows are a contiguous run owned by an ancestor rather than an alternating pattern owned by a neighbour.
